sideB.text:
CAUTIOUS APPROACH

The current player draws the next 4 Player cards, adding any City cards to their hand. Discard any other cards to the Player discard pile without effect.

Play at any time. Not an action.
sideB.footer: Play at any time. Not an action.

mechanics.whenRead: Drawn while continuing the Legacy deck at the end of the first September game, after the 09-05 pause. It is a Rationed Event, so it enters the reserve. It is not played when it comes off the Legacy deck.
triggers: Play at any time. Not an action.
addsToPool: Rationed Event: Cautious Approach (this card), to the reserve
rules: The current player draws the next 4 Player cards.
Add any City cards among them to their hand.
Discard any other cards to the Player discard pile without effect.
Play at any time. Not an action.
Discard after use. It counts toward the rationing-level pick.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the shared rationed-event back and has no printed code. The screen title is CAUTIOUS APPROACH, with three gas-mask graphics. The draw is 4 Player cards.
